messages:
Michelle: Heads-up — we're seeing a DB failover in eu-region, ~10% 5xx on inference path. Putting today's EU release on hold, deploybot just paused slots 14-18. @Ravi @Dan please confirm

deploybot: Release 3421 paused by incident hold (slot 14-18). Reason: incident_hold 

Ravi: Oncall here — investigating failover, working with infra team. ETA ~20-30m. Will post updates.

Dan: Copy. Recommend we pin control-plane binary to v2.3.1 for the paused release and roll back the recent kvcache kernel tweak that landed in canaries.

Sasha: Agreed on pin. Also suggest we limit any resumed canary to us-west only until DB is green. Otherwise we risk wider blast radius. :+1:

Kate: I'll draft change window update and tweak the release notes to mark the EU rollout deferred. Proposed new window: tomorrow 03:00 UTC for staggered rollout (canary us-west -> eu warm -> full).

Michelle: Sounds good. Dan, can you author the rollback patch, and @deploybot can you attach a block tag so CI won't accidentally resume slots?

Dan: On it. I'll push a rollback branch in a few mins and request a fast-track patch review. Plan: revert commit 9a1f3e7 (kvcache kernel opt) and bump the pinned version.

deploybot: Added blocking tag incident-1749998888 to release 3421. Auto-resume disabled.

incident-bot: INC-2026-045 created for eu-db failover. Severity: P2. Pager duty: Ravi.

Ravi: DB cluster is failing leader election due to quick succession of spot evictions. Infra is reprovisioning an i/o-stable node, testing failover now. If that stabilizes we'll consider moving slots out of pause.

Sasha: If infra gives a green, we'd still want to run a short smoke test against a pinned control plane and no experimental kernels. Any objections to that path?

Michelle: No objections. That's the plan: 1) pin 2) rollback kernel tweak 3) smoke in us-west only 4) if green, unpause eu warm, then stagger.

Dan: Pushed rollback branch: refs/changes/3421/revert-kvcache-9a1f3e7. CI queued with fast-track label.

Kate: Change window message drafted and posted to release notes. Also added a short note for customer comms: "EU rollout deferred due to infrastructure incident; working to reschedule."

deploybot: CI passed on rollback branch. Fast-track merge enabled by Dan.

Ravi: Failover finished, read replicas are syncing, error rate dropped to baseline over the last 3 minutes. Still watching for 5m.

Michelle: Good signal. Plan to run a 10-min smoke in us-west with pinned v2.3.1 and reverted kernel. Dan/Kate can you coordinate the smoke plan?

Dan: I'll run the smoke script and post results in this thread. Command I will run: 

```
./scripts/smoke-test --target=us-west --release=3421 --control-plane=v2.3.1 --no-kvcache-opt
```

Sasha: I'll stand by to approve a limited unpause if smoke looks clean.

Dan: Smoke ran: 120 requests, 0 errors, p95 latency 180ms. Logs attached to CI.

Michelle: Excellent. Sasha, can you lift the block for warm slot only (manual unpause) so deploybot can resume slot 15 as eu-warm?

Sasha: Unpausing slot 15 (eu-warm) now for verification only. Not restoring full rollout.

deploybot: Slot 15 resumed (manual). All other slots remain paused under incident-1749998888.

Ravi: Monitoring eu cluster — metrics stable for 10m, no leader flips.

Michelle: OK, proceeding with staggered plan: keep full rollout deferred, target full resume tomorrow 03:00 UTC if no regressions. Kate will publish updated change window and postmortem note once incident closes.

Kate: Will do. Drafting a short internal blurb and customer-facing line. Will also add a note in the release docs about the pin and rollback.

Dan: Merged rollback, release 3421 now pinned to v2.3.1. Please leave the incident tag until we fully resume.

deploybot: incident-1749998888 tag remains. Auto-resume still disabled.

Michelle: Thanks team. Closing action items: Dan (rollback merged), Kate (change window + notes), Ravi (monitoring + close INC), Sasha (manual unpause for verification). We'll reconvene if anything changes. :rocket:
